errors.evidence: The term "Kettenlinien" (chain lines) is not a standard German term for tick marks and the phrasing is awkward, making the description of the x-axis unclear.

errors.text_span: Die Intervalle der Tick-Beschriftungen sind in 10.000 MW beschriftet.
errors.evidence: The labeled tick marks on the y-axis are at intervals of 20,000 MW (0, 20.000, 40.000, etc.), not 10,000 MW.

errors.text_span: Eine blaue Linie, die „Bonushöhe 0,2 Eurocent/kWh“ darstellt, beginnt bei 0 MW im Jahr 2025 und erreicht Ende 2039 einen Wert von etwa 137.000 MW.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the blue line reaches about 137,000 MW. In the figure, the blue line is flat and remains near 0 MW for the entire period. The value of ~137,000 MW is closer to the final value of the black or green line.
